description.value: A Subway franchise located inside Semiahmoo Shopping Centre in Surrey, offering the chain's full lineup of Footlong sandwiches, 6" subs, wraps, salads, and breakfast items. Cycling tourists will find it a reliable, quick stop with multiple ordering options including curbside pickup and delivery. The location accepts major credit cards and is operated independently under the Subway brand.
